ranked.headline: Machine learning models score and generate ligands for defined protein binding sites
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend generative design and affinity prediction to fragments, binders, and multitarget uncertainty-aware scoring.

ranked.headline: Simulations link structural plasticity and surface charge to nucleic acid binding
ranked.summary: Residue-level MD and coarse-grained models now quantify how RNA-binding plasticity and charge govern nucleic acid interactions.

ranked.headline: Relational deep learning for drug-target interaction and binding affinity prediction
ranked.summary: Late-2025 reports combine graph attention, hybrid sequence architectures, and language-model embeddings for drug-target prediction.

ranked.headline: Histology is coupled with omics, text, and graph models for spatial tissue analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair pretrained histology representations with genomic, text, and spatial omics inputs.

ranked.headline: Multi-omics fusion models predict BRAF inhibitor sensitivity in GDSC cell lines
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test fusion architectures and protein network embeddings for BRAF inhibitor response in GDSC cell lines.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models infer treatment response dynamics from sparse or indirect data
ranked.summary: Sparse and indirect measurements are increasingly paired with mechanistic and deep-learning models to infer time-dependent treatment responses.

ranked.headline: Computational methods resolve cell identity and spatial context in single-cell data
ranked.summary: Recent frameworks address segmentation error, reference-based annotation, imputation, and cell-cell communication at population and tissue scale.

ranked.headline: Computational methods for disordered, multistate, and membrane-embedded protein systems
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair sampling control with explicit accuracy assessment for targets that lack a single ordered fold.

ranked.headline: Spatial indexing and geometric windows enable structure-level comparison of biomolecules
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply spatial indexing and 3D windowing to MD ensembles, macromolecular complexes, and sequence alignment workflows.

ranked.headline: Geometric models link cell shape and mechanics to multicellular developmental behavior
ranked.summary: Geometric representations of cells and molecules are now used to infer mechanics and predict single-cell behavior in developmental systems.

ranked.headline: Latent representations of multiscale neural activity across recording modalities
ranked.summary: Heterogeneous spatial scales, modalities, and recording durations motivate latent models fit to intracranial, LFP, spike, and MEG data.

ranked.headline: Graph and literature-grounded AI generate and trace biomedical hypotheses
ranked.summary: Learned models are increasingly tied to literature and multi-omic evidence so that generated biomedical hypotheses can be traced and tested.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-scale assemblies link genome architecture to specialized metabolite evolution
ranked.summary: Chromosome-level assemblies of a fungus, Physaria and Pseudotaxus resolve isochore, WGD and taxane pathway questions at genome scale.

ranked.headline: Learned models encode biological structure in spatial and single-cell transcriptomics
ranked.summary: Preprints and one published study now pair graph, causal, and foundation-model architectures with spatial and single-cell transcriptomics data.

ranked.headline: Benchmarked callers resolve subclonal, rDNA, and allelic variation across sequencing data
ranked.summary: Standardized truth sets and validated pipelines are needed as variant detection extends to subclonal, ctDNA, and single-cell settings.

ranked.headline: Machine learning for RNA binders, drug sensitivity, protein function, and effectors
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair new benchmarks and guidelines with learned predictors for RNA-targeting, drug response, protein function, and effector detection tasks.

ranked.headline: Multiscale models couple microbial competition, biofilm control and infection spread
ranked.summary: Linking microscale and within-host dynamics to population-level outcomes remains a central challenge for predicting microbial and infectious behavior.

ranked.headline: Extending GWAS to admixed populations, federated analysis, and non-additive effects
ranked.summary: Biobank-scale and multi-ancestry cohorts demand GWAS methods that handle admixture, privacy constraints, and non-additive architecture.

ranked.headline: Splicing variation, cryptic exons and chromatin-RNA contacts shape gene regulation
ranked.summary: Recent RNA-seq-based tools now resolve cryptic exons, natural splicing variation, and chromatin-RNA contacts across human tissues and differentiation.

ranked.headline: Auditing and completing reference genomes to judge reliability before comparative use
ranked.summary: Reference layers underpinning comparative genomics need explicit quality, provenance and taxonomic checks before biological interpretation.

ranked.headline: Models of E/I recurrent networks link criticality to spectra, avalanches and memory
ranked.summary: Explicit network models are being used to separate intrinsic criticality from latent-input effects and to reproduce avalanche statistics in cultures.

ranked.headline: Software tools for organizing, searching and benchmarking omics and imaging datasets
ranked.summary: Harmonized radiation, metagenomic, bioimaging and multi-omic datasets now ship with packaged tools for reuse, discovery and benchmarking.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale sampling resolves marine microbial, algal, and coral lineage structure
ranked.summary: Expanded isolate, metagenome-resolved, and coral genomic datasets now resolve ecotype and lineage boundaries across ocean and reef systems.

ranked.headline: Genomic AMR prediction faces calibration, workflow and sampling-bias limits
ranked.summary: Recent studies expose calibration errors, direct-from-culture detection and confounded training data as limits on genomic resistance inference.

ranked.headline: Correcting platform-level measurement effects in methylation and genotype inference
ranked.summary: Pooled methylation and genotype analyses increasingly require explicit correction for platform-specific measurement differences.

ranked.headline: Transmission models quantify arbovirus spread, sparse-outbreak rates and spillover risk
ranked.summary: Late-2025 studies apply ODE, Petri net, inverse and vectorial capacity models to a chikungunya outbreak, arbovirus control and spillover potential.

ranked.headline: New methods refine mutation attribution, metastasis reconstruction and chromatin tracing
ranked.summary: Recent methods address localization error, low-mutation attribution and multiobjective lineage inference, sharpening downstream biological conclusions.

ranked.headline: Learned sequence embeddings advance viral taxonomy and eDNA sequence annotation
ranked.summary: Learned genomic representations are now applied to taxonomy and annotation tasks where reference coverage is incomplete.

ranked.headline: Imaging and barcoding readouts link gene perturbations to single-cell phenotypes
ranked.summary: Pooled optical screens, label-free imaging, and barcoded spatial readouts now resolve perturbation effects at single-cell resolution.

ranked.headline: Single-cell and spatial profiling map tissue heterogeneity in development and disease
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell methods now resolve methylation, isoforms and trajectories at near single-cell scale, extending atlases to new tissues.

ranked.headline: Noise propagation constrains causal gene inference from static expression data
ranked.summary: A theoretical relation links expression noise propagation through reaction networks to causal gene interaction detection from static data.

ranked.headline: Biophysical models link axonal structure and stimulation physics to neural function
ranked.summary: Individualized and multiscale simulations now tie conduction, stimulation fields and whole-brain synchrony to explicit structural and physical assumptions.

ranked.headline: Reliability of single-cell and gene network inference under noisy, incomplete data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints introduce estimators that quantify uncertainty in trajectory, manifold, and network inference from sparse single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Learned models and acquisition design extend peptide and proteoform identification
ranked.summary: Deep-learning de novo sequencing, imputation-aware proteoform statistics, and narrow-window DIA now address modified peptides and depth in measured data.

ranked.headline: Scoring protein mutations, PROTAC ternary complexes and NMR-consistent structures
ranked.summary: Recent methods model protein and PROTAC structures as ensembles and score them against electronic-structure and NMR-derived criteria.

ranked.headline: Causal and non-additive models dissect plasma protein and disease genetic architecture
ranked.summary: Biobank-scale studies now apply causal network inference and dominance and epistasis detection to proteomic and disease GWAS traits.

ranked.headline: Long-read profiling of retrotransposons and isoforms in aged brain and neurons
ranked.summary: Cellular defenses against retrotransposons weaken with age, and long-read profiling is now applied to these elements and isoforms in neural tissue.

ranked.headline: Learned models guide iterative virtual screening for SARS-CoV-2 and PLK2 inhibitors
ranked.summary: Iterative deep-learning screens and consensus interaction models now yield inhibitors validated by measured potency against disease-relevant targets.
